manifest.name: System shares
manifest.description: What the box's system mounts at start and through the automounter
netfs.clear_text: The entry is taken out of the file, its password with it. Nothing that is mounted is unmounted.
netfs.lead: Shares the box's system mounts itself, also without Neutrino: at start, or on demand through the automounter under /mnt/autofs.
netfs.lead_link: The shares Neutrino mounts are under Network shares.
netfs.pass_kept: stored – leave empty to keep it
netfs.pass_note: A stored password comes off when the entry is emptied.
netfs.remote_dir: Directory or share on the server
netfs.saved_automount: Entry saved. The automounter offers it once it has been restarted.
netfs.umount_text: Every share the box has mounted is unmounted, also one this file does not name. A recording on one loses it.
netfs.unreadable: %s lines of the file could not be read. Saving an entry keeps the readable entries and drops those lines.
netfs.tip_mount_all: Mount every entry of the file now
netfs.tip_umount_all: Unmount every entry of the file now
